The '''J-10 dual blaster cannon''' was a model of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] used by droid forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The J-10 dual [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] was based on the design of the smaller [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] commonly used by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Larger in scale than the E-5 blaster, it required a tripod mount, and like other repeating weapons, fired rapid successive bursts. It was maneuvered by two handles, one for each barrel, and could be fired by a single operator.

==History==
During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], two J-10 dual blaster cannons were housed inside bunkers guarding the entrance to the city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]. They were very successful holding the forces of [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] at bay until [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] one [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|droid popper]] into each bunker, disabling all the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s located within. These weapons were also used by Geonosian insurgents during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].
